title: Reliability Initiative Lifecycle: SLIs-to-OKRs mapping and cadence manager
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Objective: Create an initiative lifecycle and lightweight automation layer that ties SLI measurement to initiative status and OKR progress for the Reliability Program. This ticket scopes a product-facing coordinator that reduces manual bookkeeping for error-budget-driven decisions and ensures consistent handoffs between PM, Eng, and Oncall.
detailed_goals: 1) Define a canonical data model that maps SLIs and error budget burn signals to initiative states (Planned, In Progress, At Risk, Throttled, Rollback, Complete). 2) Implement a cadence manager that can suggest cadence actions (pause, throttle, escalate) based on configurable thresholds and burn-rate rules. 3) Expose a single view in Console to show initiative health, active mitigations, and projected error-budget runway. 4) Provide Linear automation templates that update initiative status and create follow-up tasks when thresholds are crossed.
out_of_scope: Full automated rollback of production deploys is out of scope for this ticket — this will instead emit clear signals to runbook owners and optionally open oncall incidents. Deep integration with third-party incident platforms will be scoped separately.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical mapping doc published in Confluence (link included) and reviewed by Eng + SRE
Cadence manager prototype runs off synthetic telemetry and produces policy decisions in staging
Console view mockups approved by Design and implemented with telemetry-backed charts
Linear templates created to auto-create follow-ups and update initiative state when a configured burn threshold is reached
QA playbook showing gating behavior for canary rollouts is attached and validated in a staging run
dependencies_notes: ENG-1842 (runtime telemetry ingest): must finish the curated SLI events API. PM-74200 (slo-metrics-ledger) provides normalized SLI definitions; require schema alignment before cadence manager can act.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives from noisy SLIs may trigger unnecessary throttles. Mitigation: add debounce and burn-rate smoothing, require 2 sequential windows before auto-state changes. Risk: over-automation causing team confusion. Mitigation: default to suggest mode; require explicit approval for production-impacting actions.
communication_plan: Weekly sync with SRE triage (Thursday 11am), demo to Platform Eng bi-weekly, and a milestone review with Cross-functional Reliability Guild on 2026-03-25. Release notes and runbook updates published alongside console-2026.04 release.
customer_impact_explanation: This initiative reduces time-to-decision for error-budget events, lowering risk of production degradation and improving mean time to mitigation for customers relying on SLAs. High-priority customers will be notified of new guardrails in advance.
